summary: Debug shapes the server draws in players' worlds: lines, spheres, boxes and text labels, for a time or until cleared. Each call returns the gizmo's id, and drawing it again replaces it. Without `players` in the options, all players draw it. Gizmos end when their resource stops. To draw on one machine, use the client's Gizmos.

line.summary: Draws a line between two points.
line.exampleLua:
local Gizmo = kcds.world.Gizmo

local id = Gizmo.line(player.position, npc.position, { color = kcds.math.Color.red(), durationMs = 5000 })
Gizmo.text(npc.position, "Target", { players = { player } })
Gizmo.clear(id)

sphere.summary: Draws a sphere at a point with a radius.

box.summary: Draws a box at a point with a size. The options can also include `rotation`.
box.example: kcds.world.Gizmo.box(arenaCentre, { x: 10, y: 10, z: 2 }, { rotation: { z: 30 }, color: kcds.math.Color.yellow() });
box.exampleLua: kcds.world.Gizmo.box(arenaCentre, { x = 10, y = 10, z = 2 }, { rotation = { z = 30 }, color = kcds.math.Color.yellow() })
box.exampleCs: Gizmo.Box(arenaCentre, new { x = 10, y = 10, z = 2 }, new { rotation = new { z = 30 }, color = Color.Yellow() });

text.summary: Draws a text label at a point.
text.exampleCs: Gizmo.Text(npc.Position, npc.Name, new { players = new[] { player } });

clear.summary: Removes one gizmo or all of them, for everyone or for chosen players.
clear.exampleLua:
local Gizmo = kcds.world.Gizmo

Gizmo.clear(id, { player }) -- one gizmo, for one player
Gizmo.clear() -- all gizmos
clear.exampleCs:
Gizmo.Clear(id, new[] { player }); // one gizmo, for one player
Gizmo.Clear(); // all gizmos

params.gizmo: Optional: the gizmo's id; 0 or nothing clears all.
params.players: Optional: limits it to these players.
